answer: By the walnut of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the terrace until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the umber of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. Written in a plain sentences, numbers cited inline register, it stays short.
